name: VisitorPreRegistration
tagline: Invite, approve, badge and check in visitors – with a lobby kiosk, NDA, induction, parking and fire roll call.
description: A complete visitor management app for offices, campuses and logistics sites in one Power Apps code component. Hosts pre-register visitors, reception approves them against capacity, security-flag and parking rules, the app issues QR passes and parking bays, and the lobby kiosk checks visitors in with an NDA signature and a safety induction. The On site view runs the fire roll call; the dashboard flags overstays, late arrivals and approvals due.
features: Approval rules: date, contact, host, security flag, vehicle plate, daily site capacity
QR visitor pass generated in the control (no network)
Parking bays per site with automatic assignment and waitlist
Kiosk with NDA signature and safety induction by visit purpose
Check-in window and no-show grace rules
Overstay, late arrival and reminder alerts
Fire roll call with not-accounted output
Bulk approve / resend / status / export with skipped-rule list
Undo, confirmations, read-only, disabled and map-your-columns states
Phone layout with bottom bar, agenda and touch kiosk
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
